description: I'm part of the 35–40 person Android team behind Eurobank's mobile banking app. I led a large modularization effort, moving 1,500+ files into 10+ new modules, and brought unit tests to modules that had none, so the team can ship changes with more confidence.

I helped move the Sportsbook from WebView screens to native Android with Jetpack Compose and MVI. I kept the QA rejection rate under 3%, held the app at 96% crash-free sessions and reviewed 50+ pull requests a quarter. This is also where AI tools became part of my daily workflow (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, Gemini), helping me ship features faster without lowering quality.

I worked on the Viva.com Terminal app, used by 1M+ people in 10+ European countries. I added tablet and landscape support across 35+ screens, which let the app run on new devices like cash machines and vending machines. I also built its Kiosk mode and led the app rebranding.

Where I grew into a tech lead. I built and maintained 15+ Android apps for insurance and loyalty clients, often as the sole Android developer, including the award-winning KRAFT Pro App (Impact BITE Awards 2021) and Piraeus Bank's Yellow, a top banking app in Greece five years in a row. As tech lead I owned estimations, worked directly with clients and mentored junior developers.
